e8a4dc50bc9780fa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أسواق زاد البلد التجارية عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة، وضمان خدمة عملاء ممتازة، والمساهمة في سلاسة العمليات اليومية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ المبالغ المالية وتسجيلها في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، مع ضمان توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو الطرق الأخرى المعتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل بوجه رحب مع العملاء وتلبية رغباتهم بالإضافة أو الحذف على قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المبالغ المالية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. الالتزام بالدقة والمسؤولية في العمل. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور العمل ضمن فريق لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وتقديم أفضل خدمة للعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة أسواق زاد البلد التجارية.

e88bb0df77e5f20e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في القطيف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة تركيب وتشغيل الأجهزة الطبية، بالإضافة إلى تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية لضمان كفاءة عملها وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع مخططات تركيب الأجهزة الطبية المتنوعة مثل أجهزة غسل الكلى، وأجهزة دعم القلب والتنفس والرئة، وأجهزة التصوير والتخطيط الطبي. تحديد مواقع التركيب المناسبة ومتابعة إجراءات التركيب، وإعداد قوائم بقطع الغيار الاحتياطية الضرورية. متابعة إجراءات التشغيل التجريبي للأجهزة الطبية والتأكد من تشغيلها وفقاً لأدلة التشغيل المعتمدة. تدريب مستخدمي الأجهزة الطبية على إجراءات التشغيل السليم والضبط الصحيح. تتبع مخططات الدارات الإلكترونية للأجهزة الطبية، وتشخيص الأعطال باستخدام أجهزة الفحص والقياس، وتنفيذ إجراءات الإصلاح والضبط اللازمة. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية بحسب تعليمات الشركة الصانعة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال صيانة وتركيب الأجهزة الطبية. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق التعليمات الفنية للشركات المصنعة. القدرة على تتبع المخططات الإلكترونية وتشخيص الأعطال. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأجهزة الطبية ضمن فريق متخصص في القطيف، المنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

e8ae393c1823f083.job_title: Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) Engineer
e8ae393c1823f083.description: About 2P Perfect Presentation Since 2004, 2P Perfect Presentation has been a leader in Saudi Arabia’s ICT sector, providing integrated technology solutions that support organizations in accelerating digital transformation and enhancing operational efficiency. The company delivers end-to-end solutions through specialized business units and market expertise, maintaining a strong foundation in innovation and service excellence. The Role of VAPT Team Lead 2P Perfect Presentation is seeking a Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) Team Lead to manage the end-to-end VAPT program. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of experience. The successful candidate will lead a team of engineers, define testing strategies, and ensure that findings are validated, reported, and remediated in a timely manner. The role involves aligning the VAPT program with standards such as NCA ECC, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF. Key Responsibilities Lead, mentor, and assign tasks to VAPT engineers, reviewing their technical output and reports. Develop and manage the annual vulnerability assessment and penetration testing plan, scope, and rules of engagement. Define testing methodologies, standards, and quality checks, adhering to frameworks such as OWASP, PTES, and NIST SP 800-115. Oversee authenticated and unauthenticated scanning across servers, endpoints, network devices, databases, containers, and cloud workloads. Set risk-based prioritization using CVSS, exploitability, and asset criticality. Drive remediation efforts with IT and application owners against established SLAs, escalating overdue items as necessary. Confirm the closure of vulnerabilities through rescans and retests. Lead and personally conduct advanced penetration tests across web applications, APIs, networks, Active Directory, mobile, cloud (Azure, AWS), wireless, and social engineering. Execute red team and adversary simulation exercises in coordination with the Security Operations Center (SOC) to enhance detection and response capabilities. Review and approve executive and technical reports, ensuring clear risk ratings and practical remediation recommendations. Present results, risk trends, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to the Director and senior management. Support audits and regulatory requirements, contributing to security policies and secure development practices. Track emerging threats, tools, and techniques, and develop the team's skills and training plan. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in vulnerability assessment and penetration testing. Demonstrated leadership experience in managing technical teams. Proficiency in defining and implementing VAPT strategies and plans. Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks such as NCA ECC, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, OWASP, PTES, and NIST SP 800-115. Experience with various testing domains, including web application, API, network, Active Directory, mobile, cloud (Azure, AWS), wireless, and social engineering. Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to present technical information to diverse audiences. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic and forward-looking environment focused on digital transformation and operational efficiency.

e839bec25c0257c6.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مستشفى الهيئة الملكية بالجبيل عن استشاري أمراض القلب التداخلية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على اكتساب الخبرة والمهارات المتقدمة في طب القلب التداخلي، مع التركيز بشكل خاص على إجراءات التدخل عبر الجلد للشرايين التاجية. يساهم شاغل الوظيفة في دعم كفاءة وسلاسة سير العمل اليومي في مختبر قسطرة القلب. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الخدمات السريرية حسب التكليف من رئيس قسم أمراض القلب. إجراء عمليات تصوير الأوعية الدموية التشخيصية والتداخلية، وفقاً للصلاحيات والامتيازات السريرية المعتمدة. تنسيق إجراءات دخول المرضى وخروجهم لضمان الاستخدام الأمثل والفعال لجلسات عمل مختبر قسطرة القلب، وتعظيم الاستفادة من الطاقة الاستيعابية للأسرة في وحدة القلب. المساعدة في ضمان انسيابية وكفاءة سير العمل والخدمات السريرية في مختبر قسطرة القلب، بما يضمن تنفيذ قوائم الإجراءات بأعلى كفاءة ممكنة ووفقاً لمعايير التميز في الممارسة السريرية. ضمان توفير بيئة عمل آمنة وممارسات عمل سليمة، والحد من المخاطر التي قد يتعرض لها الموظفون أو المرضى. المحافظة على معايير مكافحة العدوى وإدارة المخاطر السريرية والامتثال للمتطلبات والأنظمة التشريعية، أو العمل على تجاوز تلك المعايير. اتخاذ الإجراءات الفورية لتصحيح أي أوضاع أو ممارسات غير آمنة، مع الإبلاغ عن جميع الحوادث والحوادث الوشيكة وفقاً لسياسات وإجراءات المستشفى. تقديم أعلى مستوى ممكن من الرعاية الطبية للمرضى المسؤول عن علاجهم. تنفيذ أي مهام ومسؤوليات أخرى ذات صلة يتم تكليفه بها، في حدود معارفه ومهاراته وقدراته، داخل المستشفى و/أو المنشآت الطبية التابعة له. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 3 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال أمراض القلب التداخلية. مهارات متقدمة في إجراءات التدخل عبر الجلد للشرايين التاجية (PCI). القدرة على تقديم خدمات سريرية عالية الجودة. بيئة العمل يعمل الاستشاري ضمن بيئة مستشفى متكاملة في الجبيل، مع التركيز على مختبر قسطرة القلب ووحدة القلب. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بمعايير السلامة ومكافحة العدوى وإدارة المخاطر السريرية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة للموظفين والمرضى. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل.

e89437651ba59a22.description: About the Role The Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu is seeking a Laboratory Technologist to join their team in Al Jubail. This full-time role is for a chartered professional who will lead complex architectural projects from inception through to IFC documentation. The position requires accountability for project utilization and adherence to budgetary constraints, while delivering creative and technical design excellence. Project Leadership and Team Coordination The Associate Principal Architect will lead multiple project teams and contribute to client relationship management. This role involves directing and mentoring project teams comprising architects and engineers, fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional development. The individual will ensure design quality, program delivery, and compliance with both budgetary and regulatory requirements across all assigned projects. Key Responsibilities Lead multiple complex architectural projects, ensuring design quality, program delivery, and compliance with budgetary and regulatory requirements. Direct and mentor project teams of architects and engineers, fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional development. Champion innovative and contextually relevant architectural solutions, maintaining high design standards throughout all project stages. Act as a primary client contact for assigned projects, building and maintaining strong relationships, managing expectations, and resolving challenges. Support architectural bid preparation, strategic planning, and resource forecasting, contributing to the firm’s growth and competitiveness. Ensure project processes align with company policies, governance frameworks, and industry standards. Provide guidance and technical leadership to less experienced team members, encouraging growth and career development. Work closely with multi-disciplinary teams (engineering, cost, PM etc.) to ensure integrated and efficient project delivery. Represent the practice in industry events, conferences, and professional organizations (*, RIBA, AIA). Required Experience Candidates for this role should possess a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in architecture, with a proven track record in leading complex projects and managing project teams. The position requires an organized and driven professional capable of overseeing projects from initial concept to final documentation. Professional Engagement Senior Associates are expected to play a visible role in representing the firm within professional organizations and at industry events. This involves active participation and contribution to the architectural community, reinforcing the firm's presence and expertise. Work Environment This role is part of a dynamic architecture studio focused on ensuring operational excellence and contributing to the success of landmark projects within the region. The position is full-time and based in KSA.

e8f635f80ceb1a23.description: About the Role Namaa Partners is seeking a Supply Chain Analyst to join its strategy team. This full-time role involves working on procurement, supply, and inventory distribution for clients. The position is remote, with the company headquarters located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The ideal candidate will contribute from the first week by collecting and transforming data into clear reports for client meetings. About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a strategic consulting firm that collaborates with various entities in Saudi Arabia and companies with significant interests there. Clients range from family groups and holding companies to listed companies, banks, insurance firms, government entities, and industrial operators. Partners define the scope of work and oversee its execution through to board-level decision follow-up. Engagement continues post-recommendation, with the team monitoring the impact of agreed-upon strategies with management. Responsibilities Collect procurement, inventory, and purchase order data from clients and organize it into unified, comparable files. Prepare analytical spreadsheets on supply costs, delivery times, and inventory levels, clearly stating data sources and assumptions. Review supplier contracts and payment terms, extracting key observations for partner review. Monitor and periodically update performance indicators such as inventory turnover rate and backorder ratio. Develop slides and drafts for presentations that clearly explain results and available alternatives. Record notes and open questions after client meetings, following up with the team until resolution. Qualifications and Requirements Basic knowledge of supply chains, acquired through studies, training, part-time work, or a university project in procurement, inventory, or supply. Proficiency in Excel for building tables, formulas, and pivot tables, along with good skills in PowerPoint. Fluency in Arabic, both written and spoken, with the ability to formulate clear written observations. Accuracy in handling numbers and organization in arranging files, sources, and dates. An organized work style that allows for managing multiple tasks simultaneously without oversight. Readiness to follow up and inquire when data is incomplete, and a desire to learn from partner feedback. Discretion in handling client information and maintaining confidentiality. What We Offer Direct involvement in real projects for reputable entities in Saudi Arabia, from data collection to client presentations. Full-time, continuous remote work, with the company headquarters in Riyadh. Daily interaction with partners who define the scope of work and oversee its execution. Practical experience in cost analysis and supply chains within a broader strategic context. Continuous review of spreadsheet and analysis preparation methods, with practical guidance on output formulation. Exposure to a diverse range of sectors: retail, manufacturing, financial services, and government. Decision-Making Process The partner defines the scope of work and tasks before an assignment begins, distributing work among team members based on the project. Analytical outputs are reviewed with the partner before reaching the client. Any ambiguity in data or expectations is addressed directly in the weekly team meeting and resolved before it causes delays. You are expected to offer your opinion on the numbers presented and to record questions requiring clarification from the client, rather than making unsupported assumptions. Escalation is a natural part of daily work, not an exception. Who Succeeds in This Role Individuals who are comfortable with spreadsheets, review their figures before submission, and write concise notes that are understandable to both partners and clients. Success also comes to those who initiate work with specific questions when client data is incomplete or conflicting, and then return with clear answers. This role is for someone who adheres to deadlines, ensures their files are comprehensible to any new reader after a week, and is willing to take ownership of figures they can defend before the partner.

e8ffd1d48401b71a.description: About the Role GCC Olayan is seeking a Product Support Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on driving spare parts sales for heavy equipment and automotive brands. The specialist will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, building customer relationships, and ensuring efficient parts quotations and order fulfillment to enhance customer satisfaction and sales profitability. Key Responsibilities Achieve assigned spare parts sales targets across various brands and product lines. Conduct regular customer site, workshop, and fleet visits to identify parts requirements and sales opportunities. Identify correct parts, prepare quotations, negotiate within approved margins, and secure orders. Follow up on orders, receivables, and overdue payments to support sales realization and collections. Maintain an active pipeline of prospective customers and business opportunities. Customer Relationship Management Develop and maintain long-term customer relationships, serving as the primary contact for spare parts. Address customer inquiries and complaints, coordinating timely resolutions. Monitor customer equipment and fleet requirements to identify current and future parts demand. Market Intelligence and Reporting Monitor competitor pricing, products, and market activities. Track equipment population by brand, model, and operating hours within the assigned territory. Identify lost sales, emerging customer needs, and potential business opportunities. Maintain accurate customer, equipment, sales opportunity, and visit records in the CRM system. Update market intelligence, lost sales, and customer activity information. Provide regular updates on sales performance, pipeline progress, and market developments. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in product support, spare parts sales, or a similar field within the heavy equipment or automotive industry. The role requires a proactive approach to sales and customer relationship management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involving regular customer site visits and interaction with various stakeholders to achieve sales objectives.

e800c9ca3ae504b4.description: نبحث عن أمين صندوق دقيق ومنظم للانضمام إلى فريقنا، لضمان إدارة العمليات النقدية بكفاءة عالية. ستشمل مسؤولياتك الرئيسية التعامل مع المعاملات اليومية، وتسجيل الإيرادات والمصروفات بدقة، وإعداد التقارير المالية اللازمة. نتطلع إلى مرشح يتمتع بمهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على العمل تحت الضغط.

e8417a74d3c09b14.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Shift Leader to join their team in Riyadh and Ad Dir'iyah. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience and involves overseeing operational tasks and supporting management in various functions to ensure smooth facility operations and guest satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Install, maintain, and perform preventative maintenance on tools, appliances, and equipment, recommending replacements as needed. Calibrate controls, gauges, and meters, and identify/operate all shut-off valves. Order, mark, and stock parts and supplies, maintaining inventory and purchase order logs. Inspect tools, equipment, and machines, and utilize computer systems for work-related information. Operate power lifts and complete life safety checklists, including fire-pump and generator run tests. Inspect fire sprinkler valves and alarm systems, and assist in developing disaster response protocols. Respond to and address guest repair requests promptly. Assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Adhere to all company and safety/security policies, report maintenance problems, hazards, accidents, or injuries, and complete required safety training. Ensure professional appearance, maintain confidentiality, and acknowledge guests according to company standards. Anticipate and address guest service needs, including assisting individuals with disabilities. Foster positive working relationships, support team goals, and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Ensure adherence to quality standards and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and cost-savings. Communicate professionally and clearly with others. Physical Requirements Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight. Stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Team Environment The Shift Leader will be part of the Marriott International team, specifically within The Luxury Collection Hotels & Resorts portfolio. This collection, with over 120 properties globally, focuses on delivering authentic experiences and personalized hospitality. The team values individuals who appreciate storytelling, have a passion for local heritage, and are committed to genuine service. Additional Duties The Shift Leader will perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

e80f2c928211dcf8.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز بوابة سمسم للرعاية النهارية عن مساعد معلم للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم أعضاء هيئة التدريس في المهام غير التدريسية، والمساهمة في تنفيذ الخطط الدراسية، وتغطية الفصول الدراسية في حال غياب المعلم الأساسي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنظيم الأنشطة الصفية واللاصفية والإشراف عليها، مثل الألعاب والتجمعات والجولات. المساعدة في إعداد المواد التعليمية والكتب المدرسية، بالإضافة إلى نسخ وترتيب المواد للفصول الدراسية. توزيع المواد التعليمية على الطلاب، مثل الاختبارات والواجبات المنزلية، وجمعها بعد الانتهاء منها. تقديم الدعم للطلاب في عملية تعلمهم، خاصة أولئك الذين يواجهون صعوبات عقلية أو بدنية أو سلوكية أو غيرها. مساعدة أعضاء هيئة التدريس في عملية وضع الدرجات وتقييم الطلاب. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على أداء الواجبات غير التدريسية بفعالية. القدرة على المساعدة في تنفيذ الخطط الدراسية المحددة. بيئة العمل يعمل مساعد المعلم ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة في مركز بوابة سمسم للرعاية النهارية بمدينة جدة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع الطلاب وأعضاء هيئة التدريس لضمان سير العملية التعليمية بسلاسة. ملخص الوظيفة هذه الفرصة مناسبة للأفراد الذين يمتلكون خبرة حديثة أو قليلة في مجال التعليم ويرغبون في المساهمة في بيئة تعليمية نشطة. يتطلب الدور التزامًا بدعم الطلاب والمعلمين، مع التركيز على المهام الإدارية والتعليمية المساعدة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

e830c9f21e395b04.description: About EPAM Systems EPAM Systems is a global provider of digital platform engineering and software development services. With over 30 years of experience, the company assists clients with digital transformation as consultants, designers, architects, engineers, and trainers. EPAM focuses on building long-term partnerships, enabling businesses to evolve through digital solutions. In Saudi Arabia, EPAM operates in Al Khobar and Riyadh, delivering engineering, strategy, design, consulting, and innovation services across various industries. Role Overview: Marketing Manager The Marketing Manager role is a full-time position focused on shaping gaming experiences for audiences in the MENA region. This position involves translating global priorities into localized campaigns that resonate culturally and drive engagement across diverse markets. The Marketing Manager will convert local player feedback into insights to guide future activations and partnerships, ensuring campaigns connect meaningfully with players. Key Responsibilities Develop MENA regional marketing strategies and go-to-market plans, localizing global priorities into market-specific, culturally relevant activations. Manage MENA campaign planning and execution, including creative direction, messaging, and go-to-market approaches to increase awareness, engagement, and player growth. Oversee budgets, agencies, and partnerships to ensure efficient resource allocation, accountability, and measurable ROI across all channels. Serve as the regional liaison across Communications, Creator Partnerships, Legal/Privacy, and Platform teams to ensure campaign alignment, compliance, and seamless execution. Act as the regional marketing lead, representing local players' perspectives, aligning global and regional teams, and translating market insights into future campaign planning. Required Qualifications and Experience At least 5 years of experience in marketing, brand, or publishing roles, preferably within gaming, entertainment, or digital consumer brands. Demonstrated ability to develop and execute go-to-market strategies tailored for the MENA region. Experience managing agencies, budgets, and marketing programs, with a focus on accountability and performance management. Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across teams and regions. In-depth understanding of digital marketing channels, social platforms, and creator ecosystems relevant to MENA audiences. Passion for gaming and digital culture, with an understanding of cultural nuances and player behaviors across regions. Additional Skills Multi-market experience or fluency in multiple languages is an advantage. Application Process Candidates who meet the requirements are invited to submit their application online by providing an up-to-date CV and/or LinkedIn profile. Optional materials such as cover letters and portfolios may also be included. The recruitment process typically involves an initial conversation with the Talent Acquisition team, followed by a technical interview and an interview with the hiring manager. A client interview may be part of the process in some cases.

e8869fc1dede2da5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قناص العربية عن طاهٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحضير وطهي مجموعة متنوعة من الأطعمة، بما في ذلك اللحوم والدواجن والأسماك والخضروات، مع ضمان أعلى معايير الجودة والنظافة في بيئات مثل الفنادق والمطاعم والنوادي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد الأولية وتجهيزها وتحضيرها وطهي اللحوم والدجاج والخضراوات والأطعمة الأخرى لإعداد الأطباق المدرجة في قائمة الطعام. تحضير الشوربات وإعداد السلطات والمقبلات الباردة والساخنة. سلق وطهي الأطعمة الشرقية بمهارة. تجهيز الأكلات بعد نضوجها ووضعها في الأواني المناسبة وتحضيرها للتقديم. الإشراف على تنظيف أدوات الطبخ والطعام والمحافظة على إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة العامة في المطبخ. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الطهي. القدرة على استلام وتجهيز وطهي مجموعة متنوعة من الأطعمة. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة الغذائية. بيئة العمل يعمل الطاهي ضمن فريق في بيئة مطبخ احترافية، مع التركيز على الكفاءة والنظافة. يتطلب الدور العمل بدوام كامل في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. التقديم للراغبين في الانضمام إلى فريق شركة قناص العربية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

e8879290cc901daa.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع حياتي العائلية الطبي عن أخصائي مختبرات طبية للانضمام إلى فريقه في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إجراء الفحوصات المخبرية وتوفير الدعم اللازم لضمان جودة ودقة النتائج، مع الالتزام بمعايير السلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد احتياجات المختبر من المواد الأولية اللازمة للفحوصات الطبية وتوفيرها، مع التأكد من سلامتها وتعقيمها ومراقبة فترة صلاحيتها. استلام عينات الفحص من المرضى وحفظها بالطرق السليمة، وإجراء التحاليل الكيميائية والفيزيائية والمجهرية اللازمة لتحديد وجود السكر أو البروتين أو الجراثيم والطفيليات. دراسة نتائج الاختبارات وإعداد التقارير المتعلقة بها بدقة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في أساليب التحاليل الطبية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالتحاليل الطبية للمريض وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال المختبرات الطبية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المختبرات الطبية. القدرة على إجراء التحاليل والفحوصات المخبرية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة المخبرية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المختبرات الطبية ضمن فريق مجمع حياتي العائلية الطبي في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم خدمات مخبرية عالية الجودة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن.

e8b14bff5a30279a.description: About the Role Reef Group is seeking a Supply Chain Excellence Senior Manager to lead continuous improvement, process optimization, governance, and performance excellence within the Group’s Supply Chain function. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on identifying operational gaps, standardizing processes, driving automation and digitalization, improving supply chain KPIs, and supporting the development of scalable operating models across various supply chain functions. Key Responsibilities Lead Supply Chain Excellence and continuous improvement initiatives across the Group. Review end-to-end supply chain processes to identify opportunities for efficiency, control, cost, and service improvement. Develop and maintain standardized supply chain processes, SOPs, policies, and governance frameworks. Define and monitor Supply Chain KPIs, dashboards, and performance management frameworks. Lead process mapping, root-cause analysis, and improvement programs across Planning, Procurement, Logistics, Warehousing, and Inventory. Drive automation, digitalization, and system enhancement initiatives within Supply Chain. Partner with IT and business teams to improve ERP, planning, reporting, and operational systems. Lead transformation projects focused on productivity, cost optimization, service levels, inventory efficiency, and operational performance. Develop and implement best practices across Supply Chain functions and business units. Support the design and improvement of Supply Chain operating models, roles, responsibilities, and workflows. Monitor performance gaps and coordinate corrective action plans with relevant stakeholders. Lead benchmarking activities and identify opportunities to adopt leading Supply Chain practices. Support change management and ensure successful implementation of new processes, systems, and ways of working. Prepare executive-level reports and presentations on performance, transformation initiatives, risks, and recommendations. Coordinate closely with Supply Chain leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. Build a culture of continuous improvement, data-driven decision-making, and operational discipline. Lead and develop the Supply Chain Excellence team and support capability building across the wider Supply Chain organization. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in Supply Chain Excellence, Transformation, Process Improvement, Performance Management, and Operational Excellence. Demonstrated ability to work across multiple functions and lead complex improvement initiatives. Experience in a fast-paced and growing organization is preferred. Impact of the Role As Supply Chain Excellence Senior Manager, you will contribute to building stronger processes, improving performance, enabling digital transformation, and creating scalable Supply Chain capabilities that support Reef Group’s continued expansion.

e8f0af1355e98ce7.description: About Basamh Group Basamh Group is a consumer-centric organization with over 75 years of experience, serving the MEA region. The group's operations include Basamh Trading Company (BTC) for retail distribution and Specialized Food Services (SFS) for HORECA. GoodyCo manages marketing and brand building, while Thokoman Foods handles manufacturing. The company operates with core values of true ownership, passion to grow, transparency, and family spirit, aiming to build long-term partnerships and support community development. The Role of Sales Executive Basamh Group is seeking a Sales Executive to join its sales team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on driving sales growth, managing client relationships, and identifying new business opportunities. The position requires 2-5 years of experience, strong communication skills, product knowledge, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a dynamic environment. Key Responsibilities Achieve monthly and annual sales targets for assigned accounts. Identify and acquire new clients to expand the company’s market presence. Maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing customers to ensure retention and repeat sales. Promote and present company products, ensuring comprehensive product knowledge and effective positioning. Support the execution of trade promotions, activation, and in-store visibility initiatives. Monitor customer orders, coordinate deliveries, and follow up to ensure service quality. Handle day-to-day customer queries and resolve issues to maintain client satisfaction. Track competitor activities and market trends, sharing insights with the sales management team. Provide accurate sales reports, forecasts, and updates to the Regional Sales Manager. Ensure timely collection of receivables from assigned customers. Support product launches by driving distribution, visibility, and sales in the assigned area. Represent the company during client visits, tastings, and local trade events. Required Qualifications and Skills 2-5 years of experience in a sales role. Excellent communication skills. Strong understanding of product offerings. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Results-oriented and motivated to achieve sales targets. Work Environment and Culture Basamh Group is committed to fostering a culture of growth and innovation. The company supports continuous professional development through hands-on learning, online resources, interactive training, and personalized coaching. Guided by a family spirit, the environment aims to ensure individuals feel valued, supported, and empowered to contribute to collective success.

e88d9c2cfd4ecd2f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركه ابراهيم القاسم للبورسلان و الرخام عن مدير مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى قيادة عمليات المبيعات وتطوير الأعمال ضمن قطاع البلاط والرخام والسيراميك. سيساهم شاغل الوظيفة في زيادة حجم المبيعات وبناء علاقات استراتيجية مع العملاء والمقاولين والمطورين العقاريين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة وتوجيه عمليات المبيعات لتحقيق الأهداف المحددة. تطوير استراتيجيات فعالة لزيادة حجم المبيعات في قطاع البلاط والرخام والسيراميك. بناء وتعزيز علاقات قوية ومستدامة مع العملاء الحاليين والجدد. توسيع شبكة العلاقات مع المقاولين والمطورين العقاريين. تحديد فرص عمل جديدة وتطويرها لنمو الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال المبيعات، مع تركيز خاص على قطاع البلاط والرخام والسيراميك. فهم عميق لسوق البناء والمقاولات والعقارات. سجل مثبت في تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتطوير الأعمال. مهارات قوية في التفاوض وبناء العلاقات. بيئة العمل والموقع يقع مقر هذا الدور في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع للتعامل مع العملاء والشركاء. المزايا والراتب تقدم الشركة راتباً شهرياً يتراوح بين 7,500 ريال سعودي و 11,250 ريال سعودي، بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين وذوي الخبرة لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في شركه ابراهيم القاسم للبورسلان و الرخام.

e84916f9ba273521.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة قمة النكهات للحلويات عن صانع حلويات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يساهم شاغل الوظيفة في إعداد وتجهيز مجموعة متنوعة من الحلويات والمخبوزات، وتطوير وصفات جديدة، والمشاركة في إعداد قائمة الحلويات. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والنظافة وتنظيم العمل داخل المطبخ. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتجهيز مختلف أنواع الكيك والتشيز كيك والحلويات والمخبوزات. تحضير المكونات ووزن المقادير بدقة وفقاً للوصفات المعتمدة. تنفيذ الوصفات مع ضمان الجودة والطعم والشكل النهائي للمنتجات. تجهيز الحشوات والكريمات والصوصات والتزيينات اللازمة. المساعدة في ابتكار وتطوير وصفات حلويات جديدة والمشاركة في تحديث قائمة الحلويات. تجربة الوصفات وتعديلها للوصول إلى أفضل النتائج، وتوثيقها بالمقادير والخطوات. تجهيز طلبات العملاء والمقاهي حسب جدول الإنتاج، مع الالتزام بالكميات والمواعيد المحددة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب المطبخ والأدوات والمعدات، ومتابعة المخزون. الالتزام باشتراطات سلامة الغذاء والنظافة الشخصية. المساعدة في تجهيز المكونات والأدوات للدورات وورش العمل التدريبية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة سابقة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في إعداد الحلويات والمخبوزات. معرفة جيدة بأساسيات الخَبز وتقنيات تحضير الحلويات. الدقة في تنفيذ الوصفات والالتزام بالمقادير. يفضل وجود خبرة في تطوير الوصفات وإعداد قائمة الحلويات. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. القدرة على تحمل ضغط العمل. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والجودة والنظافة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. يعمل صانع الحلويات ضمن فريق المطبخ، ويسهم في بيئة عمل منظمة وملتزمة بمعايير الجودة والنظافة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

e8600ad078aadec8.description: About the Role Jazeera Paints is seeking an Accountant to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves performing daily accounting activities for assigned branches, focusing on accurate recording of sales transactions, customer cash collections, and petty cash movements. The Accountant will support branch financial controls and ensure all tasks comply with company policies and procedures, providing accurate financial information to the Accounting Supervisor. Key Responsibilities Receive, review, and accurately record customer collections in the accounting system, ensuring proper documentation and compliance. Coordinate with bank representatives to verify and follow up on customer collection deposits, ensuring timely and accurate processing. Perform daily showroom sales closing procedures, reconcile sales transactions, and report any discrepancies to the Accounting Supervisor. Conduct regular stock counts for showrooms and warehouses, reconcile physical inventory with system records, and report variances. Record and maintain accurate records of branch petty cash expenses monthly, ensuring transactions are submitted by the 25th of each month. Perform daily reconciliation of cash, sales transactions, and system records, reporting discrepancies or unresolved issues. Verify and record branch sales invoices, credit notes, and related accounting transactions for completeness and accuracy. Maintain proper filing and organization of accounting documents, including invoices, receipts, and collection records, for review and audit. Support the monthly closing process by completing assigned accounting activities, reconciling branch balances, and providing required reports within defined timelines. Execute all function-related activities using safe and environmentally sound methods. Perform any other duties assigned by the direct supervisor or manager. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the Accountant will be responsible for supporting the financial operations of assigned branches within Jazeera Paints. Application Process Candidates interested in this Accountant position are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry.

e8a811a8a1eef639.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز ريادة الغد للعلاج الطبيعي عن أخصائي علاج وظيفي للانضمام إلى فريقه في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مساعدة المرضى في تحسين قدرتهم على أداء مهام الحياة اليومية والعمل، بالإضافة إلى تعليمهم كيفية استخدام المعدات التكيفية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة المرضى في تحسين قدراتهم على تنفيذ مهام الحياة اليومية والعمل. تدريب المرضى على أداء الأنشطة اليومية مثل ارتداء الملابس، الطهي، وتناول الطعام. استخدام التمارين البدنية لزيادة القوة واستعادة البراعة الجسدية والتغلب على مشاكل التنسيق الحركي. تعليم ذوي الإعاقات الدائمة كيفية استخدام معدات التكيف، بما في ذلك الكراسي المتحركة، الجبائر، والأدوات الخاصة المساعدة في تناول الطعام وارتداء الملابس. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. القدرة على مساعدة المرضى في تحسين قدراتهم الوظيفية. المعرفة بمعدات التكيف وكيفية استخدامها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل الأخصائي ضمن فريق متخصص في مركز ريادة الغد للعلاج الطبيعي، مع التركيز على تقديم رعاية شاملة للمرضى. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى وذويهم. القدرة على التكيف مع احتياجات المرضى المتنوعة. الالتزام بتطوير المعرفة والمهارات في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. يُشجع المرشحون الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

e8ac54afeb6c33d7.description: About the Role WSP in the Middle East is seeking a Senior Stakeholder Architect to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is crucial for supporting a growing portfolio of complex projects within the region. The role involves acting as a primary interface between architectural and multidisciplinary design teams, clients, project stakeholders, authorities, consultants, and delivery partners. Role Purpose and Contribution The Senior Stakeholder Architect will ensure that stakeholder requirements are clearly understood, coordinated, and integrated into the design process. This position supports the timely progression of approvals and key project milestones. It is suitable for an architect who combines strong architectural and technical understanding with effective stakeholder management, communication, and coordination skills. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate daily engagement with key project stakeholders across architectural workstreams. Act as an interface between clients, architectural teams, multidisciplinary design teams, consultants, contractors, and relevant authorities. Understand stakeholder requirements and ensure their appropriate capture, communication, and integration into the design process. Support the architectural leadership team in managing stakeholder expectations, design interfaces, and key project commitments. Coordinate stakeholder comments and requirements across design stages, monitoring their incorporation and close-out. Maintain clear stakeholder registers, action trackers, interface logs, approval trackers, and decision records. Support submissions and approvals with relevant Saudi authorities and other project stakeholders as applicable. Identify stakeholder-related risks, interface issues, and potential approval constraints early, escalating them as appropriate. Facilitate and participate in stakeholder workshops, design coordination meetings, technical reviews, and client presentations. Prepare professional presentations, reports, meeting records, and briefing materials for senior stakeholders. Collaborate with architects, engineers, project managers, BIM/digital teams, and other disciplines to maintain coordinated project delivery. Support the resolution of architectural and multidisciplinary interface issues arising from stakeholder requirements. Monitor stakeholder actions against the project program and follow up with responsible parties to ensure timely closure. Provide architectural input into stakeholder discussions and communicate the impact of changes on design, program, and deliverables. Support Principal and senior project leadership in high-level client and stakeholder engagements when required. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Architecture or a closely related discipline. Professional architectural registration or membership is advantageous. A minimum of 10 years of relevant architectural/design experience, with substantial involvement in large or complex multidisciplinary projects. Strong experience in stakeholder management, architectural coordination, design management, or technical interface management. Experience working with multidisciplinary design teams across architecture, structures, MEP, and specialist disciplines. Previous experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East is highly advantageous. Required Skills Understanding of design development, technical coordination, authority submissions, and approval processes. Ability to review technical information and translate complex design matters into clear stakeholder communications. Experience maintaining stakeholder matrices, design comment trackers, approval schedules, and action registers. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

e8ad6d80cc42f875.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عايد عيد العصيمي للجيوتقنية عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على مراجعة وتدقيق استمارات البيانات، بالإضافة إلى إدخال وتخزين المعلومات بدقة في أنظمة الحاسب الآلي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة استمارات البيانات وترميزها والتأكد من اكتمال جميع المعلومات المطلوبة. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات إلى أنظمة الحاسب الآلي باستخدام البرامج المخصصة. مراجعة رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة وتصحيح أي أخطاء موجودة. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بشكل منظم وفعال. إنشاء النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة لضمان سلامتها. الالتزام الصارم بالتعليمات والإرشادات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات وحمايتها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدخال البيانات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على العمل بدقة واهتمام بالتفاصيل. مهارات جيدة في استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج إدخال البيانات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. يعمل مدخل البيانات ضمن فريق متخصص، ويسهم في الحفاظ على دقة وسلامة البيانات التشغيلية للشركة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التواجد في مقر الشركة بالرياض. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة عايد عيد العصيمي للجيوتقنية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

e8ec0b562840a473.job_title: Senior Design Electrical Engineer Thermal Generation
e8ec0b562840a473.description: About the Role Tractebel is seeking a Senior Design Electrical Engineer, Thermal Generation, to join our team in Makkah, with operations extending to Jeddah. This full-time role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in large thermal power projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing specifications, coordinating design reviews, and managing design works in collaboration with contractors and consultants, while also ensuring internal coordination across various disciplines. Key Responsibilities Prepare comprehensive specifications for electrical systems. Coordinate and conduct design reviews of engineering documents submitted by EPC contractors. Manage design works in collaboration with contractors and consultants. Ensure effective internal coordination with other engineering disciplines. Review and verify design calculations and studies, including electrical Hazop and risk assessments. Evaluate and review a wide range of engineering documents such as Master Documents List (MDL), design criteria, schematic diagrams, SLDs, interface drawings, load lists, and Electrical Equipment GA drawings. Attend Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) if required, and review FAT procedures and reports. Review construction, commissioning reliability, and performance test procedures and reports. Assess method statements for construction and installation. Conduct vendor materials procurement reviews and evaluate proposed vendor/supplier designs and drawings. Manage design and field changes as required, and review as-built drawings. Evaluate claims and change orders, and contribute to the close-out report for LSTK Steam Power Plant Gas Conversion Projects. Required Experience and Skills Candidates must possess extensive experience in the design, engineering, and review of EPC submitted engineering documents related to the Electrical discipline. This includes a thorough understanding of the entire project lifecycle from initial design to close-out. Proficiency in reviewing various engineering documents, including IFC/AFC/AFI drawings, red markup, and as-built drawings. Experience in evaluating claims and change orders. Demonstrated ability in risk assessment and mitigation strategies. Strong leadership qualities. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, approved by the Saudi Council of Engineers. Minimum of ten (10) years of relevant experience in large Thermal Power Projects. Thorough knowledge of relevant International Standards. Proficiency in relevant electrical design software. Well-versed in MS Office and familiar with Management Information Systems (MIS). Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.

e8a0ceb04780deb5.job_title: Associate Account Manager Cloud Business (Saudi National)
e8a0ceb04780deb5.description: About the Role InnovationTeam is seeking a Cloud Sales Associate (Saudi National) to join its Cloud team in Riyadh. This full-time role is focused on supporting and expanding cloud opportunities within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The position involves engaging new prospects to build the cloud pipeline, conducting discovery and assessments, and preparing solution outlines and funding requests for cloud services across major platforms. Key Responsibilities Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer infrastructure, workloads, and cloud strategies. Deliver cloud assessments and position InnovationTeam's funded assessment offers. Prepare high-level solution outlines and cost estimates using hyperscaler pricing calculators. Support proposals, customer presentations, and technical responses for Cloud business RFPs. Identify opportunities eligible for hyperscaler funding programs (*, AWS MAP, Google Cloud RaMP, Microsoft Azure Migrate and Modernize). Prepare and submit funding requests in coordination with the partnership team. Engage target accounts via phone, LinkedIn, and email to generate new cloud opportunities. Research target accounts for cloud buying signals such as data center refreshes or digital transformation plans. Qualify opportunities based on budget, decision-maker, need, and timeline. Book discovery meetings with qualified prospects. Support cloud events, webinars, and joint campaigns with AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft, and Alibaba Cloud, including attendee follow-up. Register opportunities in partner portals like AWS ACE and Google Cloud Partner Advantage. Coordinate with hyperscaler account managers and partner sales managers on shared opportunities. Reporting and Documentation Log all activities, contacts, and opportunities within the company CRM under the Cloud business line. Provide weekly reports on prospect engagement, meetings held, assessments delivered, and pipeline creation. Required Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on cloud opportunities across AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Alibaba Cloud platforms. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, as part of the InnovationTeam Cloud team.

e8c279cfba1a8ee6.description: About the Role Arla Foods is seeking a Logistics Team Leader to join their team in Taif, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading operational tasks, ensuring warehouse efficiency, and managing inventory to support timely distribution. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Contribute to daily operational tasks with flexibility and adaptability, promptly informing management of any issues. Ensure adherence to all warehouse procedures (SOPs), including inbound and outbound processes, warehouse operations, and inventory management. Prepare and execute the daily operational plan accurately within established parameters. Oversee inventory, handle goods, and maintain accurate warehouse records, ensuring effective stock control, proper storage, and timely distribution. Understand customer needs and build strong collaborative relationships both internally and externally. Coordinate with planners, Sales, and commercial operations to ensure timely order delivery. Prepare and provide drivers with all necessary documents, such as route plans, delivery notes, invoices, RTV documents, Bayan, and Ajeer documents, prior to departure. Receive documentation and address complaints or inquiries related to sales. Ensure departmental compliance with Arla Foods’ standards, policies, and local applicable laws. Promote a healthy, inclusive, and safe working environment with a strong safety mindset. Maintain quality and food safety within the area of responsibility. Manage the maintenance of the warehouse, machinery, material handling equipment, and trucks. Support Arla’s sustainability practices within the scope of the role. Embrace a digital transformation mindset, utilizing data to inform decision-making. Develop team competencies through coaching and enablement, aligned with Arla’s Leadership and Character principles. Demonstrate leadership and values consistent with Arla’s culture. Participate in learning and development activities. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Basic understanding of machinery, equipment, and fleet used in a warehouse environment. Ability to coordinate with relevant functions to ensure timely maintenance of material handling equipment. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Taif, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic logistics operation. The role requires a commitment to maintaining Arla Foods’ standards for quality, safety, and operational excellence.

e85da9836d473d81.description: About the Role Dow is seeking a Senior Customer Manager to drive revenue growth through catalyst, technology, and services sales for existing Univation customers across the Middle East. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically in Thuwal or Makkah City, and reports directly to the Regional Sales Director. Role Overview The Senior Customer Manager will manage and strengthen strategic customer relationships while identifying opportunities across polyethylene and advanced chemical technologies, including UNIPOL™, UNIGILITY™, METEOR™, and LP Oxo™. The role involves close collaboration with regional and global Sales, Marketing, and Technology Delivery teams to develop and execute customer strategies and achieve commercial objectives. Key Responsibilities Drive commercial growth with existing licensees across the Middle East by identifying, developing, and executing opportunities for catalysts, licensing products, technology solutions, and services. Lead commercial activities from proposal through execution, including catalyst sales, plant capacity expansions and retrofits, licensing-right modifications, improvement programs, process control solutions, plant simulation solutions, proprietary equipment, training, on-site services, and joint technology development agreements. Manage and strengthen customer relationships throughout the licensee lifecycle, coordinating with Sales, Marketing, and Technology Delivery teams to develop and execute account strategies. Support new licensing opportunities and customer transitions by partnering with the New Build Licensing Sales Manager and taking commercial ownership of catalyst and services relationships following project design confirmation and kick-off. Provide commercial leadership throughout project implementation, supporting licensees during design, construction, plant start-up, and warranty phases while coordinating delivery in accordance with applicable license agreements. Develop market and customer insights by maintaining visibility of licensees' investment plans, projects, and technology needs; sharing relevant intelligence internally; and supporting customer engagement activities. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in customer management or sales within the chemical or related industry. Demonstrated ability to drive commercial growth and manage complex sales cycles. Experience in managing strategic customer relationships and coordinating with cross-functional teams. Work Environment and Travel This role requires regular collaboration with regional teams, as well as Marketing, Technology Delivery, and Catalyst Sales colleagues. Customer engagement spans technology licensing, project implementation, start-up, warranty, and post-start-up commercial activities. Participation in industry events in the region is also expected. Regional travel up to 50% is required. Relocation support and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

e875c370a57de5bb.description: About Unifonic and the Role Unifonic, recognized as a Great Place to Work®, is an AI-native customer experience platform focused on emerging markets. With over 25 years of conversational AI research, Unifonic serves more than 5,000 enterprises across MENA, pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform. This full-time Key Account Manager role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, and is central to managing the company's perception among buyers, analysts, media, and the broader market. Role Overview The Key Account Manager will build and maintain strong relationships with strategic enterprise customers while driving business growth. This position involves managing key accounts, understanding customer business objectives, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering value through Unifonic's solutions. The role requires serving as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, developing strategic account plans, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success, retention, and revenue growth. Strong relationship management, strategic thinking, and commercial acumen are essential to achieve business objectives and maximize long-term customer value. Key Responsibilities Manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise customers. Develop trusted relationships with key stakeholders and executive sponsors. Create and execute strategic account plans. Identify opportunities for account expansion through additional products and services. Conduct regular business reviews and ensure customer satisfaction. Collaborate with Customer Success and other internal teams to maximize customer value. Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, and CRM records. Identify opportunities to expand business within existing accounts. Build relationships with prospective enterprise customers through networking, referrals, and industry engagement. Lead commercial discussions and solution presentations. Prepare proposals, negotiate contracts, and support the sales process through deal closure. Contribute to achieving the team’s revenue and growth objectives. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 6 years of experience in Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, or Strategic Account Management. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field. Experience in SaaS, CPaaS, Cloud, AI, or other enterprise technology solutions. Proven track record of managing enterprise customers and driving revenue growth. Strong business development and solution-selling capabilities. Demonstrated experience in executive stakeholder management and strategic account planning. Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills. Ability to identify growth opportunities, manage sales pipelines, and achieve commercial targets. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver customer success. Required Skills and Tools Proficiency in CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent. Strong forecasting and pipeline management skills. Data analysis and reporting to support account growth and business decisions. Strategic planning and account growth management. Proposal development and commercial documentation. Commercial acumen with the ability to develop customer-centric solutions. Customer relationship management (CRM) best practices, including customer retention and expansion strategies. Professional Attributes Analytical thinking and problem-solving. Ownership and accountability. Effective communication across teams. Collaboration and support for team goals. Adaptability and continuous learning. Mentorship and knowledge sharing. Resilience under pressure and constructive handling of setbacks. Commitment to quality and attention to detail. Advocacy for best practices, efficiency, and innovation.

e8e8608b763baa14.description: About Camco CAMCO – Capital Metro Company is a Saudi-French joint venture between RATP Dev and SAPTCO. The company is responsible for the operation and maintenance of Riyadh Metro’s Blue and Red Lines, playing a key role in operating one of the world’s largest fully automated metro networks. With over 3,000 employees, CAMCO delivers safe, reliable, and efficient metro services across Riyadh. Role Overview The PSD Engineer supports the PSD Manager in prioritizing workloads based on operational and safety demands, aligning with business needs. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, involves assisting maintenance teams with troubleshooting complex issues and ensuring asset maintenance adheres to quality standards. The engineer will ensure assets are safe, reliable, and compliant, developing solutions with guidance from experienced peers and superiors. The position requires 3-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Provide oversight for asset maintenance, planning, strategy, predictive, and condition-based maintenance for PSD systems. Execute maintenance and repair activities for relevant equipment according to work plans and maintenance manuals. Ensure quality standards are maintained during all maintenance activities. Support the hiring, training, and assessment of team staff, and manage ongoing personnel training and development. Assist the PSD Senior Engineer and technical directorate superiors with Root Cause Analysis and Incident Reporting for faults, failures, and incidents. Support the PSD Senior Engineer and technical team in the creation, review, modification, and approval of maintenance documentation, design drawings, and documents. Execute and/or supervise complex maintenance activities performed by internal teams or sub-contractors. Ensure team safety by following all safety processes and correct tool usage; create and distribute safety/quality briefs and toolbox talks to supervisors. Review CMMS logs and attachments to ensure maintenance teams follow best practices. Review change management processes to prevent operational impact. e86d89a0684f7dfe.description: Job description Company Description Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF). Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene. Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector. Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities. About LIONS Riyadh LIONS Riyadh marks a bold new chapter for the world’s most prestigious platform for creative marketing. Launched by Tahaluf in partnership with LIONS and Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Media, it is a distinct Festival within the global LIONS community, home to the renowned Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity. Designed to amplify Middle Eastern creativity on the global stage, LIONS Riyadh will showcase the region’s talent, ideas and storytelling while connecting its creative industries with the world’s leading networks, brands and decision-makers. The inaugural three-day Festival takes place at KAFD, Riyadh, from 6–8 December 2027. It will bring together regional and global CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands and emerging talent around creative excellence, effectiveness, culture and the future of the industry. Job Description The team is looking for a Conference Producer who can demonstrate they have their finger on the pulse of a fast-paced and ever-changing industry. The Conference Producer will support the development and delivery of the LIONS Riyadh content programme, researching the ideas, people and industry shifts shaping creativity, marketing, media, technology and culture. The successful candidate will be confident speaking to expert speakers from around the world and presenting the unique opportunity to showcase their knowledge and expertise at the Festival. The role requires curiosity, strong research and writing skills, excellent organisation and the confidence to build relationships with senior speakers and industry figures. Working closely with the Senior Conference Producer and Head of Content, the Conference Producer will help develop relevant session ideas, identify speakers, manage speaker communications and support the smooth delivery of the programme onsite. Key Responsibilities Conference Production Produce high-level, relevant industry conference programmes. Research and develop session ideas across creativity, marketing, media, technology, culture and emerging industry trends. Liaise with key professionals, institutions and companies in the development of conference programmes. Engage with recommended speakers and confirm their attendance. Identify strong global, Saudi and regional speakers and contributors relevant to the LIONS Riyadh audience. Ensure the speaker database is updated with accurate and current speaker information. Prepare and communicate creative briefs to the Marketing team. Prepare speaker briefs, session outlines and moderator notes with support from senior content leads. Assist in the provision of relevant leads to Commercial and Partnerships teams where appropriate. Conduct post-Festival analysis including session performance and audience feedback. Support programme scheduling, speaker logistics and order-of-show preparation. Market Research and Industry Networks Effectively research topics with relevant industry professionals and target audiences. Develop new programme ideas and content through meetings, interviews and research. Stay informed on trends across advertising, marketing, media, technology, entertainment, culture and the creator economy. Identify key opinion leaders, institutions and companies relevant to the Festival. Maintain existing relationships and build new industry contacts to support content development. Research emerging regional and international talent, campaigns, ideas and case studies that may be relevant to LIONS Riyadh. Support the development of content formats including workshops, masterclasses, debates, case studies and other Festival sessions. Help ensure strong representation of Saudi, regional and international voices across the programme. Speaker & Delegate Liaison Liaise and network with speakers, partners and delegates onsite to maintain strong service standards and gather feedback. Assist with onsite duties throughout the Festival, including extended working hours where required. Coordinate speaker communications, briefing calls, biographies, session information and onsite requirements. Support speaker rehearsals, stage management and order-of-show delivery. Build positive relationships with speakers and contributors to support future LIONS Riyadh editions. Qualifications Educated to degree level or equivalent Degree or professional background in media, marketing, communications, journalism, creative industries or a related field is advantageous. Relevant content, editorial or industry experience may be considered in place of formal qualifications. Background Knowledge, Skills & Experience Essential Minimum two years of experience in conference production, content development, editorial, media or a related role. Speaks and writes clearly and fluently in English and Arabic. Strong research skills. Strong copywriting and proofreading skills. Commercial awareness. Brand and market awareness. Good understanding of the creative, advertising, marketing, media or communications industries. Ability to turn research into relevant session ideas and clear programme copy. Confident communicating with senior speakers and external stakeholders. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple speakers, sessions and deadlines. Curious, proactive and interested in emerging cultural and industry trends. Strong attention to detail and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced team environment. Desirable Experience within advertising, marketing, media, entertainment or creative industries. Experience working on conferences, Festivals, media platforms or cultural events. Existing network across regional brands, agencies, creators or media organisations. Saudi Arabia or GCC market knowledge. Experience working with international speakers or senior industry figures. e8aadece5a977063.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an experienced E&I Designer (CS) to join their team. This full-time role focuses on providing construction support for marine and shipbuilding projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering design and technical support to shipyard production teams, resolving design issues, and ensuring compliance with project specifications and marine standards. Role Overview The E&I Designer (Construction Support – CS) will play a critical role in supporting shipyard production by addressing electrical and instrumentation-related design challenges. This involves updating production drawings, verifying design accuracy and constructability, and ensuring adherence to all applicable marine standards. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Provide construction and production support for Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) design activities in marine and shipbuilding projects. Prepare, review, and revise E&I design deliverables. Review shop drawings and production information to identify discrepancies and resolve E&I design-related issues. Offer technical support to shipyard production teams for electrical and instrumentation installation, assembly, and construction activities. Resolve technical queries (TQs), drawing discrepancies, cable routing conflicts, and installation-related design problems. Incorporate engineering changes, production feedback, and redline mark-ups into drawings, cable schedules, and 3D models. Coordinate with Hull Structure, Hull Outfitting, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, and other engineering disciplines to ensure proper integration and avoid design clashes. Verify cable routing, equipment locations, installation clearances, and interfaces with marine equipment and structural arrangements. Review vendor drawings, equipment specifications, and technical documentation for compatibility with project design requirements. Ensure E&I design deliverables comply with project specifications, applicable marine standards, classification requirements, and shipyard construction practices. Support constructability reviews and identify potential installation constraints before execution. Maintain updated production drawings, cable schedules, design records, and technical documentation in accordance with project procedures. Coordinate with engineering teams, equipment vendors, and production personnel to ensure timely resolution of design issues. Support as-built drawing updates and incorporate final production modifications, where required. Ensure design deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. Required Qualifications and Experience Hands-on experience in Construction Support (CS), shipyard production support, and production drawing modifications. Strong experience in electrical and instrumentation layouts, cable routing, equipment installation, and associated production drawings. Proficiency in marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting, or other client-accepted shipbuilding CAD software. Experience preparing and modifying 2D production drawings, 3D models, cable routing layouts, termination drawings, and installation details. Good understanding of marine electrical systems, instrumentation installation, cable trays, cable glands, junction boxes, earthing, and bonding arrangements. Ability to interpret electrical and instrumentation drawings, wiring diagrams, cable schedules, equipment specifications, vendor documentation, and production mark-ups. Experience resolving technical queries and supporting shipyard production teams during electrical and instrumentation installation activities. Familiarity with marine electrical standards, applicable IEC requirements, classification society rules, and project specifications. Experience coordinating with Hull Structure, Hull Outfitting, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, and other engineering disciplines. Experience in new-build shipbuilding projects, offshore vessels, FPSOs, or similar marine engineering projects is preferred. Exposure to international shipyards, marine EPC contractors, or multidisciplinary engineering environments is preferred. Skills and Attributes Strong technical problem-solving, drawing interpretation, coordination, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and shipyard production environment.

e8567ab5459737e7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة المجال العربي عن مهندس أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بمسؤوليات أساسية تتعلق بتركيب وصيانة وتشخيص الأجهزة الطبية لضمان كفاءة الأداء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط وبرامج متكاملة لتركيب الأجهزة الطبية، بما في ذلك أجهزة التصوير الإشعاعي والموجي، وأجهزة التشخيص والمعالجة. تدريب المستخدمين على التشغيل السليم والفعال للأجهزة الطبية المركبة. تشخيص الأعطال الفنية في الأجهزة الطبية ومتابعة جميع إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إجراء الفحوصات الدورية واللازمة للتأكد من دقة أداء الأجهزة الطبية وكفاءتها. تطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها بانتظام. تطوير وتحسين أساليب وإجراءات العمل الهندسية ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، مع توضيح نسب التقدم وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال هندسة الأجهزة الطبية. معرفة قوية بتركيب وصيانة وتشخيص أعطال الأجهزة الطبية المختلفة. القدرة على تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيل الأجهزة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص في مكة المكرمة، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية العالية ومواكبة التطورات التقنية المستمرة في مجال الأجهزة الطبية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة مجموعة المجال العربي، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للوظيفة المتاحة في مكة المكرمة.

e8af97b96676cdd3.description: Role Purpose: Execute product engineering, design development, and technical support activities for AMCO’s upstream Oil & Gas product portfolio. e8768d39694af156.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a Project Controls Director to provide strategic leadership for planning, scheduling, cost management, risk management, change control, progress measurement, performance reporting, and project governance. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, and requires over 20 years of experience. The role is responsible for implementing and maintaining robust project controls processes, systems, and procedures to support informed decision-making and effective program delivery. Key Responsibilities The Project Controls Director will work closely with the Client, PMO leadership, designers, consultants, contractors, and key stakeholders to establish an integrated controls framework. This framework will monitor project performance, identify emerging risks, and ensure alignment with approved budgets, schedules, and project objectives. Responsibilities include: Establishing and leading the Project Controls function within the PMO across all phases of the program lifecycle. Developing and implementing project controls policies, procedures, standards, and governance frameworks. Building, leading, and mentoring an integrated team of planning, scheduling, cost, risk, reporting, and controls professionals. Providing strategic advice to PMO and executive leadership on project performance, risks, opportunities, and recovery strategies. Ensuring consistent application of project controls processes across all projects, consultants, and contractors. Schedule Management Directing the development, review, integration, and maintenance of program and project schedules. Ensuring alignment and integration of design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover schedules. Monitoring critical paths, key milestones, interfaces, and dependencies across the program. Leading schedule performance reviews and recommending mitigation or recovery measures. Overseeing schedule risk analysis and ensuring robust planning practices are adopted across all workstreams. Cost and Risk Management Leading the development and maintenance of program budgets, forecasts, and cost control systems. Monitoring program expenditure, commitments, cash flow, and forecast final costs. Reviewing and challenging cost forecasts and performance data for accuracy and accountability. Ensuring timely reporting of cost performance, variances, trends, and management actions. Supporting PMO leadership in assessing commercial risks, claims, changes, and contractual implications.
